decision: Accept as qualified research evidence; no unresolved material documentation defect found in reviewed scope. Not production integration or live-availability clearance.

resolved_findings.issue: UAAAN restricted historical observation appeared as an ordinary reserve with replay links.
resolved_findings.resolution: Master Markdown explicitly marks policy-excluded/do not replay and suppresses query/detail links; restricted reserve remains unselected.

resolved_findings.issue: Country file existence was counted as completed live assessment regardless of source status.
resolved_findings.resolution: Builder distinguishes documented/completed/incomplete states. All 25 final dossiers have completed bounded assessments after recovery; failures remain qualified.

resolved_findings.issue: UNAM Aleph session/set links appeared durable.
resolved_findings.resolution: Master query and book cells identify transient state and point to the fresh-session recipe.

resolved_findings.issue: Iraqi union-supplied local links needed the same unverified-detail label as Thai union links.
resolved_findings.resolution: All four Iraqi union rows and all Thai rows carry the qualification.

resolved_findings.issue: Nested ReMA record_request POST method was not recognized by the inventory renderer.
resolved_findings.resolution: Renderer reads nested request methods and exposes POST detail with a request-recipe link.

resolved_findings.issue: Mutable default in Mexico generator copied UAAAN restriction into Guanajuato blockers.
resolved_findings.resolution: Coordinator/adapter review corrected generator to blockers=None with list copy. Final independent review confirms Guanajuato 404/no_published_rules/empty blockers and UAAAN restricted.

resolved_findings.issue: Synthesis overstated Nepal/Tanzania selected Koha counts and included Vietnam's test reserve among selected families.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final summaries correctly show Nepal four Koha plus PMB/custom; Tanzania four Koha plus ZLSB custom; Vietnam selected group excludes Koha.

limits: Manual semantic review concentrated on shared catalogs, unusual statuses, related editions, session flows, custom APIs and late recoveries; string presence alone is not a holding or edition certificate.
The policy audit covers declared query and linked-record paths, not every redirect, source request, timing interval or future use.
Disclosed Congo UCC and Turkish Millet initial crawl-delay deviations and UAAAN's incorrect initial policy interpretation remain historical facts.
Some scale claims rely on indexed sources or institutional proxies; dates, units and scopes are not comparable national rankings.
Public search, bibliographic listing, institution association, physical copies, current circulation, reader entitlement and reuse rights remain distinct.
Earlier proxy failures do not establish national infeasibility; recovered responses are preserved separately from prior failures.
No app integration, production provider, authentication, hold, outreach or deployment was performed by this review.
